title: glslkit reflection manifest
description: Build-time reflection data extracted from GLSL shader programs. This is the contract between glslkit-core (including a future ruby.wasm build) and any runtime consumer (e.g. a WebGL binding). Consumers MUST tolerate uniform/attribute locations resolving to null/-1 at runtime: unused declarations may be stripped by the GLSL compiler even though they are recorded here.

schema_version.description: Stays 1 while this schema is unreleased/unpublished, since there is no compatibility to preserve yet. Bump to 2 the first time a required field is added after the schema is published.

generator.description: Optional provenance marker set by tools that build this manifest from real GLSL sources (e.g. `Glslkit::Manifest.build`, `rake glslkit:embed`), of the form "glslkit/<version>". Absent on hand-written manifests, which bypass glslkit's validation entirely. Consumers MAY warn when it is missing, but MUST NOT require it (optional, not required, so existing manifests stay valid).

program.description: A vertex+fragment shader pair, auto-derived from a matching .vert/.frag filename. Both stages are required in v0.1.

path.description: Path relative to the shader load path, as passed to the preprocessor.

digest.description: SHA256 hex of the flattened (post-#include) source for this stage.

url.description: Asset pipeline URL for the compiled stage, if published (e.g. by Propshaft).

array_size.description: 1 for non-array declarations, so consumers never need to special-case the scalar case.

location.description: Explicit `layout(location = N)`, or null if unspecified (the runtime must look it up itself, e.g. via getAttribLocation). A non-null value here is not a guarantee the driver kept that location: unused declarations may be optimized away, so runtime location lookups can still fail and consumers must tolerate that.

uniform.description: Uniforms sharing a name across stages are merged into a single entry; `stages` records which stages declared it. A type mismatch across stages is a build error (StageMismatchError), not represented here.

setter.description: WebGL2 setter method name, per Glslkit::Types.

matrix.description: True if `setter` is a uniformMatrix*fv variant requiring a transpose argument.

sampler.description: True for sampler/image types, which are set via uniform1iv with texture unit indices.

components.description: Component count of a single array element (e.g. vec3 -> 3, mat4 -> 16, sampler types -> 1).

element_count.description: components * array_size. The expected length of the array passed to `setter`.

layout.description: GLSL packing layout (std140, std430, packed, shared). Defaults to "shared" per the GLSL spec when no layout qualifier is present in source.

binding.description: Explicit `binding = N`, or null if unspecified.
